analysis.file_name: GS Blekos - ## US Equity 2027 Outlook Nvidia Whitbread Prysmian Europe Indus Barometer Puig Neste Dassault Abu Dhabi Bank ## 18 Nov 2026.pdf
analysis.title: US Equity 2027 Outlook / Nvidia / Whitbread / Prysmian / Europe Indus Barometer / Puig / Neste / Dassault / Abu Dhabi Bank
key_insights: GS forecasts the S&P 500 will rise 17% to 8,700 by year-end 2027.
GS expects EPS growth to slow from roughly 30% in 2026 to 18% in 2027. Drivers are earnings, a solid economy and continued AI investment.
The S&P 500 forward P/E has declined 19% in 2026 and sits near its 10-year average. GS expects rates and AI uncertainty to keep the P/E near 18x.

GS 2027 themes: AI Productivity Candidates (Exhibit 50), Buyback Aristocrats (Exhibit 51), Energy Infra, Transport, HC (biopharma, managed care), and selected Staples (beauty, energy drinks, nicotine).
Nvidia: GS expects the stock to hold its gains after a solid quarter with CY27 guidance raised ahead of Street expectations. Investor positioning is neutral-to-negative per GS conversations.

Nvidia: GS says management commentary should bolster investor confidence in the fundamental outlook for Nvidia and the broader AI ecosystem, although significant uncertainty remains on several fronts.

Whitbread: GS upgrades to Buy with a 12-month price target of 3,700p, about 32% upside. GS says earnings, returns on capital and shareholder returns will improve sooner and more steeply than the market expects, while shares trade near their 10+ year trough multiple.

Prysmian: GS reiterates Buy after 3Q26. It raises FY26-28E adj EBITDA by c.3%-2% on the 3Q26 beat and a higher 4Q26 barometer. GS sees EBITDA above the top end of 2026 guidance and expects 2027 adj EBITDA guidance above €4bn at full year results.
Prysmian drivers: mix improvement from the Transmission backlog and better Digital Solutions margins on fiber price tailwinds and higher volumes from Channell (40% EBITDA margins).

Europe multi-industry: US Capital Goods PPI decelerated sequentially in October but remains 2.7 pp above its 20-year median. GS ties the slowdown to Iran conflict developments and improved tanker traffic.
China October PPI rose 0.7 pp sequentially versus September. European September PPI accelerated sequentially and stayed 2.5 pp above the historical median.
Puig Brands is reportedly in final talks to acquire Parfums de Marly.
Neste: GS reiterates Buy, citing volume growth, strong FCF generation and an undemanding valuation.

Dassault Systemes: after its 2026 Capital Markets Day, GS says a re-rating depends on sales execution and delivery on the path to double-digit revenue growth. Investor focus is on sales execution, the AI product rollout and proof of AI monetization.
Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank: GS upgrades to Buy, saying it is well positioned to capitalize on growth.
